subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

The muscles on his chest and arms was not well defined.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the singular form of the verb 'was' is incorrect.
 
• The subject '**muscles'** is **plural**, so the verb should also be in** plural form.**
 
• Therefore, the plural form of the verb 'were' should be used in place of the singular form 'was'.

Hence, the correct sentence is "*The muscles on his chest and arms **were not well defined***."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In sentences where the subject is plural, the verb must also be plural.
 
• If the subject is singular, the verb must be singular.
 
• **Example:** *The dog **is** barking loudly*.
